Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.ETable Class¶

class Instruments.oscilloscope_rigol.ETable(instrument, data_handler, n)[source]¶

Bases: object

The ETable commands are used to set the parameters related to the decoding event table.

__init__(instrument, data_handler, n)[source]¶
get_column()[source]¶

Query the current column of the event table.

Parameter: None

Return: str: “DATA”, “TX”, “RX”, “MISO”, or “MOSI”

get_data()[source]¶

Read the current event table data. If auto save is on, then also saves them to a csv file.

Parameter: None

Return: bytes: Raw event table data (TMC header included)

get_disp()[source]¶

Query the status of the decoding event table.

Parameter: None

Return: int: 1 (on) or 0 (off)

get_format()[source]¶

Query the data display format of the event table.

Parameter: None

Return: str: “HEX”, “ASC”, or “DEC”

get_row()[source]¶

Query the current row of the event table.

Parameter: None

Return: int: Current row, or 0 if table is empty

get_sort()[source]¶

Query the display type of the decoding results in the event table. Parameter:

None

Return:

str: “ASC” or “DESC”

get_view()[source]¶

Query the display mode of the event table.

Parameter: None

Return: str: “PACK”, “DET”, or “PAYL”

set_column(col)[source]¶

Set the current column of the event table.

Parameter: col (str): “DATA”, “TX”, “RX”, “MISO”, or “MOSI”

Return: None

set_disp(state)[source]¶

Turn on or off the decoding event table.

Parameter: state (int or str): 1/0 or “ON”/”OFF”

Return: None

set_format(fmt)[source]¶

Set the data display format of the event table.

Parameter: fmt (str): “HEX”, “ASCII”, or “DEC”

Return: None

set_row(row)[source]¶

Set the current row of the event table.

Parameter: row (int): Row number (1 to max rows)

Return: None

set_sort(sort)[source]¶

Set the display type of the decoding results in the event table.

Parameter: sort (str): “ASCEND” or “DESCEND”

Return: None

set_view(view)[source]¶

Set the display mode of the event table.

Parameter: view (str): “PACKAGE”, “DETAIL”, or “PAYLOAD”

Return: None
